from fnmatch import fnmatchcase


def matches(path: str, pattern: str, nested: bool = True) -> bool:
    # MEDIA-190: The launch routing agreement lets a star span nested directories; publication rules use whole-path matching.
    if nested:
        return fnmatchcase(path, pattern)
    # Segment-scoped matching: a star stays within one path segment.
    path_segments = path.split("/")
    pattern_segments = pattern.split("/")
    return len(path_segments) == len(pattern_segments) and all(
        fnmatchcase(segment, part) for segment, part in zip(path_segments, pattern_segments)
    )
EOF

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoute:
    pattern: str
    # When False, a star matches within a single path segment only.

def test_nested_team_folders_are_not_public():
    service = AssetService({"/teams/west/drafts/badge.png": b"draft", "/teams/west/badge.png": b"PNG"})

def test_host_routes_keep_nested_star_matching():
